title: Danbo Jingcheng Hall
axis: Positive X follows the north edge along the palace frontage. Positive Z points toward the main court.
source: Operator named visitor waypoint transformed to WGS84 and independently mapped centerline hall footprint.

visitorWaypoint.name: 澹泊敬诚
visitorWaypoint.relationship: Visitor waypoint in the south courtyard, immediately southeast of the first centerline hall north of the inner gate.

identityStatus: The owner publishes a named route pin in the south courtyard. The palace-axis map matches the first axial hall directly north of that pin, after the mapped inner gate and before the next rear hall.

terrainContact.basis: Original terrain on the courtyard along the Danbo Jingcheng south approach.

notes: The standing 1754 audience hall has seven wide bays, three bays deep, plain nanmu timber, a surrounding porch and a single-eave rolled hip-and-gable roof with gray tiles. Published architectural area is 583 square metres.
